maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring PEO services: payroll, HR, workers' comp and benefits for client employees, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private small and mid-sized business clients across construction, healthcare, hospitality and other industries, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by adding PEO clients through local branch teams; no roll-up acquisition pattern evident.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced payroll, workers' comp coverage, benefits and HR compliance are embedded; switching PEOs means disruption and regulatory risk.
